description: Global project chat on CE while Alice and Bob have the editor open and Dave (a viewer) listens on a scripted websocket: send with and without client_id, a viewer sending, paging with limit and before, editing your own message, editing and deleting somebody else's (refused, even for the owner), bad content, and each author deleting their own messages at the end so the project chat is empty again. chat.json holds every REST step with sentAt/answeredAt on the same clock as the frames.
notes: ol-capabilities for alice: ["chat","link-sharing"]
bob sends with client_id: 204; event minus 204 (ms): alice 5, bob 5, dave 2
alice sends without client_id: 204; event minus 204 (ms): alice 9, bob 9, dave 1
dave (viewer) sends: 204; event minus 204 (ms): alice 2, bob 2, dave 1
new-chat-message keys: id,content,timestamp,user_id,room_id,user,clientId; user keys id,first_name,last_name,email; without client_id the keys are id,content,timestamp,user_id,room_id,user
alice sends page message 1: 204; event minus 204 (ms): alice 2, bob 2, dave -1
alice sends page message 2: 204; event minus 204 (ms): alice -1, bob 0, dave -2
alice sends page message 3: 204; event minus 204 (ms): alice 2, bob 0, dave -1
alice sends page message 4: 204; event minus 204 (ms): alice 0, bob 0, dave -1
pages: Paging message 4 f | Paging message 3 f | Paging message 2 f // Paging message 1 f | Dave the viewer ca | Alice answers with // Hello from Bob, wi
